The workshop has wrapped up. Your completion certificate lists the modules you
attended across all four sessions, so please take a moment to check that we recorded
you correctly before certificates go out.

Enter the email address you used to register or to join Zoom:

```{=html}
<form id="attendance-form" class="attendance-form" autocomplete="on">
  <label for="attendance-email" class="visually-hidden">Email address</label>
  <input id="attendance-email" name="email" type="email" class="form-control"
         placeholder="you@institution.edu" required>
  <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Look up</button>
</form>
<div id="attendance-result" aria-live="polite"></div>
<p class="text-muted small">Records last updated: <span id="attendance-updated">—</span>.
Attendance is taken from the Zoom participant reports, which count minutes in the session.</p>
```

You will see the name and email addresses we have for you, and your status for each
module. If anything is wrong, **use the button under your record to reach us**: it
opens a pre-filled email with your attendance summary so we can correct your record
before certificates are issued.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## How your details are protected

This page has no list of participants to browse. Each person's record is encrypted
with a key made from their own email address, and the lookup runs entirely in your
browser. Only someone who types your exact address can open your record.

That does mean anyone who already knows your email could check your attendance. If you
would rather they couldn't, email us and we will remove your record from this page.
:::

## Feedback

Tell us what worked and what you would change — it is **anonymous**, takes about three
minutes, and shapes the version the next cohort gets.

```{r}
#| label: feedback-setup
#| include: false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# This is a utility page, not a teaching page -- the code here is plumbing
# rather than content, so the chunks set `echo: false` rather than the
# site-wide `echo: true`. Please leave it that way; CLAUDE.md's "code is
# always visible" rule is about teaching code.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(reactable)
source("R/reactable_utils.R")

# --- Where the survey lives ------------------------------------------------
# SWAP POINT: this is the only place the survey URL appears.
SURVEY_URL <- "https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScIijc_VR9vu8Oflb8Mkk_VxQNG7JNQXMiL8dti-VFvexfdkg/viewform"

survey_ready <- !is.null(SURVEY_URL) &&
  nzchar(SURVEY_URL) &&
  grepl("^https?://", SURVEY_URL)

# --- Aggregated results ----------------------------------------------------
# Paths are relative to the repo root because _quarto.yml sets
# `execute-dir: project`.
#
# IMPORTANT: these files may legitimately not exist yet (they do not until the
# first responses are aggregated by R/summarise-feedback.R). There is no
# `freeze` in _quarto.yml, so this chunk re-runs on every CI render -- if it
# errored on a missing file, the whole site would fail to deploy. Hence the
# guard.
summary_path <- "data/feedback-summary.csv"
meta_path    <- "data/feedback-meta.csv"

feedback     <- NULL
n_responses  <- NA_integer_
last_updated <- NA_character_
have_results <- FALSE

if (file.exists(summary_path)) {
  feedback <- readr::read_csv(summary_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  have_results <- nrow(feedback) > 0
}

if (have_results && file.exists(meta_path)) {
  meta <- readr::read_csv(meta_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (nrow(meta) > 0) {
    n_responses  <- meta$n_respondents[1]
    last_updated <- as.character(meta$last_updated[1])
  }
}

if (have_results) {
  # Response options are ordered by the `order` column, never alphabetically --
  # otherwise "Too fast" would sort before "About right". Levels are taken
  # across all questions, which relies on a label never carrying two different
  # `order` values; R/summarise-feedback.R enforces that.
  lev <- feedback |>
    distinct(response, order) |>
    arrange(order) |>
    pull(response) |>
    unique()

  feedback <- feedback |>
    arrange(question_id, order) |>
    mutate(
      question = factor(question, levels = unique(question)),
      response = factor(response, levels = rev(lev))
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: feedback-cta
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

if (survey_ready) {
  cat(
    "[**Open the feedback survey →**](", SURVEY_URL, ")",
    "{.btn .btn-primary target=\"_blank\"}\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "::: {.callout-warning}\n",
    "## Survey link not configured yet\n\n",
    "The feedback survey is not linked from this page yet. If you are looking\n",
    "to leave feedback, please email the organisers in the meantime.\n",
    ":::\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## See what people have told us so far

```{r}
#| label: feedback-headline
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

if (!have_results) {
  cat(
    "_No responses have been summarised yet. Once the first batch comes in,_\n",
    "_this section fills with the grouped counts for every question._\n",
    sep = ""
  )
} else {
  bits <- character(0)
  if (!is.na(n_responses))  bits <- c(bits, paste0("**", n_responses, " responses**"))
  if (!is.na(last_updated)) bits <- c(bits, paste0("last updated ", last_updated))
  cat("Based on ", paste(bits, collapse = " · "), ".\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: feedback-chart
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-alt: "Horizontal bar charts showing how many participants chose each answer, with one panel per feedback question."

if (have_results) {
  p <- ggplot(feedback, aes(x = n, y = response)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#593196") +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.35, size = 3.2, colour = "grey30") +
    facet_wrap(~question, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
    labs(x = "Number of responses", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0)
    )
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: feedback-table
#| echo: false

if (have_results) {
  feedback |>
    select(Question = question, Response = response, Responses = n) |>
    mutate(across(c(Question, Response), as.character)) |>
    grouped_reactable(
      group_var = "Question",
      id = "feedback",
      height = 420,
      columns = list(
        Question  = reactable::colDef(minWidth = 260),
        Response  = reactable::colDef(minWidth = 160),
        Responses = reactable::colDef(maxWidth = 130)
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: feedback-footnote
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

if (have_results) {
  cat(
    "\nOnly grouped counts are shown. Written comments are not published.\n",
    "The underlying summary is available as ",
    "[a CSV](../data/feedback-summary.csv).\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```
